endings.title: The Tower Opens
endings.text: Every cover-up fell, and you hardly took a wrong step. The doors of the tower stand open, and ordinary people walk in to read their own records.
endings.message: Check before you believe, and you help keep power honest.

endings.title: Cracks in the Wall
endings.text: The tower is exposed, but you stumbled on the way. The powerful already point at your mistakes and ask the public whom to trust.
endings.message: Even true evidence loses force when it is shared with errors. Verify first, then speak.

endings.title: The Cover-Up Lingers
endings.text: You reached the top, but too many guesses along the way. The people hear your story, then the rebuttal, and no one is sure whom to believe.
endings.message: Guessing helps the people who profit from confusion. Slow down and check every source.

flag_notes.text: You kept the fund clerk's name out of it, and the clerk spoke up safely.
You used the fund clerk's name, and the clerk lost their job. Protecting people who speak up matters.
You refused the envelope, and honest people trusted you with more.
You took an envelope. It cost you the trust of the people who saw it.
